emails.subject: Embedded development support for {{company_name}}

Hi {{first_name}},

I noticed {{company_name}} is working on {{product/device/technology}} and wanted to reach out.

Many hardware companies reach a point where their internal team is managing multiple projects and additional embedded expertise would help them move faster.

MBEDTRONIX supports companies with embedded software, firmware, and electronics development when they need additional engineering capacity without adding full-time hires.

Would it make sense to explore if external development support could be useful for your current or upcoming projects?

Best regards,
